_comment: What counts as screenshot drift, in one place: read by CI's Doc Screenshots job (the advisory check on a PR) and by regenerate-doc-screenshots.yml (which stages only the images this policy flags), through compare-screenshots.ts --policy. The thresholds and every exclusion are explained in .claude/rules/documentation.md's screenshot section; an image is excluded here only when it differs between two runs of an unchanged tree for a reason no regeneration can settle.
